options.systemMessage: You are a conservative B2B email reply classifier. Classify only the supplied latest reply, respect explicit opt-out language, and output strict JSON.

parameters.jsCode:
const result = $('Restore Reply Result').all(0)[$itemIndex]?.json || {};
const event = $json || {};
const eventError = event.error?.message || event.errorMessage || '';
return {
  json: {
    event_type: 'lead_reply_processed',
    lead_id: result.id || '',
    company_name: result.company_name || '',
    incoming_message_id: result.incoming_message_id || '',
    gmail_thread_id: result.gmail_thread_id || '',
    from_email: result.from_email || '',
    reply_intent: result.reply_intent || '',
    reply_confidence: result.reply_confidence ?? null,
    status: result.final_status || '',
    meeting_requested: Boolean(result.meeting_requested),
    pricing_question: Boolean(result.pricing_question),
    do_not_contact: Boolean(result.do_not_contact),
    human_review_required: Boolean(result.human_review_required),
    next_follow_up_at: result.next_follow_up_at || null,
    next_workflow: result.final_next_workflow || '',
    lead_updated: Boolean(result.lead_update_ok),
    lead_update_error: result.lead_update_error || '',
    event_logged: !eventError,
    event_log_error: eventError,
    completed_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }
};

options.systemMessage: You write concise, respectful B2B follow-up emails for CodeNativeX. Use only supplied facts and return strict JSON.

parameters.jsCode:
const value = $json || {};
return {
  json: {
    id: value.id,
    outreach_id: value.outreach_id,
    company_name: value.company_name || '',
    email: value.email || '',
    follow_up_number: Number(value.follow_up_number || 0),
    next_outreach_attempt: Number(value.next_outreach_attempt ?? value.outreach_attempts ?? 0),
    follow_up_body: value.follow_up_body || '',
    follow_up_outcome: value.follow_up_outcome || 'follow_up_failed',
    final_status: value.final_status || 'follow_up_failed',
    final_outreach_status: value.final_outreach_status || 'failed',
    latest_gmail_message_id: value.latest_gmail_message_id || value.gmail_message_id || '',
    latest_gmail_thread_id: value.latest_gmail_thread_id || value.gmail_thread_id || '',
    last_follow_up_at: value.last_follow_up_at || null,
    next_follow_up_at: value.next_follow_up_at || null,
    final_next_workflow: value.final_next_workflow || '',
    final_error: value.final_error || '',
    completed_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }
};
